# Google Groups

> > A platform hosting mailing lists, discussion forums, and Usenet archives spanning programming, science, hobbies, and community interests.

Google Groups serves as a comprehensive discussion platform hosting thousands of communities ranging from technical forums like comp.lang.c and Selenium Users to specialized interest groups covering birding (IBET - Illinois Birders), paleontology (Dinosaur Mailing Group), aviation soaring, and regional communities. It preserves Usenet archives and enables email-based group communication with configurable privacy settings.

## Key Topics

- Google Groups platform
- Usenet archives
- Email discussion lists
- Community forums
- IBET (Illinois Birders Exchanging Thoughts)
- Illinois Ornithological Society
- Anticensority browser extension
- C programming language
- Selenium browser automation
- Bird sightings and ornithology
- Paleontology and dinosaur research
- Aviation soaring and gliding
- Privacy settings and group management
- Technical support discussions
- Regional community boards

## Platform Information

- [About Google Groups](https://groups.google.com/g/googlegroups/about): Google Groups about page with group info and privacy settings

## Technical and Programming Communities

- [comp.lang.c](https://groups.google.com/g/comp.lang.c): C programming language discussion forum and Usenet archive
- [Selenium Users](https://groups.google.com/g/selenium-users): Selenium browser automation community support and help mailing list

## Science and Nature Communities

- [IBET - Illinois Birders Exchanging Thoughts](https://groups.google.com/g/ilbirds): Illinois birding community group for sightings and ornithology discussion
- [Dinosaur Mailing Group](https://groups.google.com/g/DinosaurMailingGroup): Paleontology community for dinosaur research and fossil publications

## Hobby and Recreation Groups

- [RAS_Prime](https://groups.google.com/g/rasprime): Aviation soaring and gliding community discussion group

## Regional and Local Communities

- [Mattole Valley Bulletin Board](https://groups.google.com/g/mattole): Restricted access community bulletin board for Mattole Valley

## Support and Troubleshooting

- [Opera Proxy Settings Conflict](https://groups.google.com/g/anticensority/c/aBfZaDUs3TE): Opera proxy settings conflict troubleshooting for Anticensority extension
- [Website Blocking in Russia Region](https://groups.google.com/g/anticensority/c/kCGBdZHNzqo): Website blocking issue in Russia region for Anticensority extension
- [Steam Workshop Image Loading Issue](https://groups.google.com/g/anticensority/c/o-bgIIJW2o4): Steam Workshop image loading issue troubleshooting discussion
